item.title: Adobe ColdFusion RDS Path Traversal → Arbitrary File Read/Write → RCE (CVE-2026-48282)
item.description: Critical severity (CVSS 10) — web · CVE-2026-48282 (Adobe APSB26-68). Status: Weaponized — arbitrary file read/write, directory browsing, webshell deployment, and command execution all confirmed. Affects: Adobe ColdFusion — Remote Development Service (RDS), /CFIDE/main/ide.cfm. Tags: coldfusion, adobe, rds, path-traversal, cwe-22, unauthenticated, remote, webshell, kev, actively-exploited.
